speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mutton broth, and you will look at the loaf before you look at him. Two fingers short of the notch. It is a penny.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two fingers. A penny. I am looking.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. If this is a play, I will have the plot before the broth is cold.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A question first. Gillis, what is a weaver proudest of?

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The shuttle thrown true. That, before the rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And after the shuttle?

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The beam. The reed. The thrum, which is the waste end left on the loom.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the core you wind the thread on. What do you call that?

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The bottom. A clew of yarn is a bottom of thread. A man who winds well is half a weaver.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A bottom of thread.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Give me the packthread. I will tie the weaver's knot twice. Then you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You showed me the knot when the days were long. In July you gave me three words. Thread, the shuttle, and the knot. These today are not those.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Twice. There. Now your hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. It holds.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Three words of my own tongue. One for bread. One for thread. One for good evening. Hear them. Do not write the letters.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have them in the ear. I am not writing them down.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He heard them. I will not pretend I did.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The plot. I have waited through a knot. What is this?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A duke's wedding. Tradesmen who make a play for it. And in the wood, fairies.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tradesmen playing! Then it is a satire upon players, and I approve it. The fairies are popery.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Does the weaver get to be in the play?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He wants to be all of it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then he is proud of the wrong thing, if he wants every part and will not wind one bottom.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have the plot. Eat the broth. The loaf is not growing back.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Two fingers. I saw the notch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two fingers, and a penny, and one word I mean to keep. I am not writing the play at this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not. One candle if you write the word upstairs. You have said you have no page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No page. One word. I know which.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Good evening, when you go up. You have the knot again.
